content.text:
I added `GET /api/me/export` in `src/app/api/me/export/route.ts`. It returns 403 for anyone who isn't a patient and builds the export from the signed-in patient's own id. It returns the patient fields (including `mrn`), their appointments, every message they sent or received (with `direction`), and their clinical notes. I added `listForUser` to `repos/messages.ts` and `listClinicalForPatient` to `repos/notes.ts`, and the new file `tests/export.test.ts` has two tests.

Psychotherapy notes are never read, because the export queries only `clinical_notes`. It also leaves out appointment `notes` and `reason_for_care`, which aren't in the spec. Each export writes an audit entry with ids only. Typecheck and all 20 tests pass.
